NORMALIZED_RULE: The protocol SHALL initialize with state IDLE.
The protocol SHALL begin a new session only when state is IDLE.
On OPEN_REQ(id) in IDLE, the protocol SHALL record id and set state to OPEN_SENT.
On entry to OPEN_SENT, the protocol SHALL start open_timer and set open_retry_count to 0.
On OPEN_ACK(id) in OPEN_SENT with id equal to session_id, the protocol SHALL set state to OPEN.
A nonmatching OPEN_ACK SHALL NOT transition the protocol to OPEN.
When transmission begins in OPEN, the first new local DATA sequence number SHALL be 0.
Each accepted new local DATA SHALL use a sequence number exactly one greater than the preceding accepted new local DATA.
The protocol SHALL accept no new local DATA while tx_outstanding is present.
On DATA_ACK(session_id, seq) matching tx_outstanding, the protocol SHALL clear tx_outstanding.
A DATA_ACK for tx_last_acked with no matching outstanding item SHALL be accepted idempotently.
A DATA_ACK whose sequence exceeds the next locally valid acknowledgment sequence SHALL return invalid and not mutate state.
The protocol SHALL deliver received DATA only when state is OPEN.
In OPEN, inbound DATA at rx_expected_seq SHALL be delivered once and advance rx_expected_seq by 1.
In OPEN, inbound DATA at rx_last_delivered SHALL be acknowledged and SHALL NOT be delivered again.
In OPEN, inbound DATA with seq greater than rx_expected_seq SHALL be rejected and SHALL NOT advance rx_expected_seq.
Inbound DATA whose session identifier differs from session_id SHALL return invalid and not mutate protocol state.
The protocol SHALL initiate local close only on CLOSE_REQ in OPEN.
The protocol SHALL accept local CLOSE_REQ only when tx_outstanding is absent.
A valid CLOSE_REQ SHALL set state to CLOSE_SENT and start close_timer.
On CLOSE_ACK matching session_id in CLOSE_SENT, the protocol SHALL set state to CLOSED.
On ABORT in OPEN_SENT, OPEN, or CLOSE_SENT, the protocol SHALL immediately set state to ABORTED.
In ABORTED, the protocol SHALL reject all events except RESET.
On RESET in ABORTED, the protocol SHALL set state to IDLE and clear all session state.
On RESET in CLOSED, the protocol SHALL set state to IDLE.
On RESET in a state other than ABORTED or CLOSED, the protocol SHALL return invalid and not mutate state.
On an open_timer timeout before the abort threshold, the protocol SHALL retransmit OPEN_REQ.
On the third consecutive open_timer timeout without a matching OPEN_ACK, the protocol SHALL set state to ABORTED.
On a data_timer timeout for tx_outstanding before the abort threshold, the protocol SHALL retransmit tx_outstanding.
On the third consecutive data_timer timeout without a matching DATA_ACK, the protocol SHALL set state to ABORTED.
On a close_timer timeout before the abort threshold, the protocol SHALL retransmit CLOSE_REQ.
On the third consecutive close_timer timeout without a matching CLOSE_ACK, the protocol SHALL set state to ABORTED.
A successful matching OPEN_ACK, DATA_ACK, or CLOSE_ACK SHALL reset its corresponding retry counter to 0.
For an event invalid in the current state, the protocol SHALL return an explicit invalid result and SHALL NOT mutate protocol state.
In CLOSED, a duplicate CLOSE_ACK for session_id SHALL be ignored without reopening or aborting.
After a valid RESET and a subsequent new session, the protocol SHALL not retain prior-session state that affects the new session.
